capabilities_done: D28 strip (flatten_purge.rs strip_structure, called from sanitized_save.rs redact_and_save_opts when options.structure_tree == Strip and at least one region was flattened): removes the catalog's /StructTreeRoot and /MarkInfo, every /StructParents, /StructParent and /SE entry of every dictionary (to Limits::depth_cap), every object with the shape of a structure element (structure_shaped, the same predicate check_document reads: /Type /StructElem or /StructTreeRoot, /S name + /P + text key, /Type or /S past the hop bound) with every direct reference to it (scrub_references), and every such dictionary written directly inside another object (array element nulled, dictionary entry removed). Returns whether something the saved file would hold was removed.

API (lib.rs exports): redact_and_save_opts(doc, regions, policy, &RedactOptions { text, structure_tree }, cancel); StructureTreePolicy { Strip (default), KeepNotProven }; RedactionLoss { AccessibilityTagsRemoved } with code() 'accessibility_tags_removed' (same typed-enum + code() pattern as NotProven/FlattenNote); RedactedOutput::losses (sorted, unique). redact_and_save and redact_and_save_with keep their signatures and use the default Strip.
Opt-out StructureTreePolicy::KeepNotProven: today's behaviour (neutralize_structure best effort, check_document reports the tree: region_flattened false, NotProven::ResidualInRegion).
check_document unchanged in role: runs after the strip for both policies, so anything the strip cannot reach stays reported (fail closed).

claim.text: redact_and_save / redact_and_save_with / redact_and_save_opts with the default StructureTreePolicy::Strip: when at least one region is flattened, the saved file holds no /StructTreeRoot, /MarkInfo, /StructParents, /StructParent or /SE entry and no dictionary with the shape of a structure element that the strip can reach (objects of the document and dictionaries written directly in them), RedactedOutput::losses is [AccessibilityTagsRemoved] when the saved file would otherwise have held any of them, and a tagged document can read region_flattened / region_cleared / is_proven. Content streams are unchanged (marked-content operators with /MCID stay). What the strip cannot reach (an element that is a member of an object stream the file keeps as a stream, an element an alias object keeps reachable) is reported by check_document (region_flattened false, NotProven::ResidualInRegion). StructureTreePolicy::KeepNotProven keeps the pre-D28 behaviour. A save with no region strips nothing.

notes.typed_loss_pattern: press has no prior typed-loss struct; RedactionLoss follows the crate's existing typed enum + code() pattern (NotProven::code, FlattenNote::as_str, FlattenCause::as_str) and is carried on RedactedOutput like xfa_removed / flattened notes; no receipt mechanism added
design_choices: strip only when a region is flattened (PLR-101 scope: the structure rules apply only then; a no-region save keeps tags)
/SE removed as a key (the outline item stays), elements removed as objects (references scrubbed), direct element dictionaries removed where they sit
loss reported only when something the saved file would hold was removed (unreachable leftovers are not written anyway); /MarkInfo alone counts as tags removed
neutralize_structure still runs after the strip (no tree left: 0 neutralized)
residuals_fail_closed: an element member of an object stream kept as a stream (R24 K1): not edited, reported by check_document
an element reachable through an alias object (top-level reference object): the alias is not a dictionary, the element stays reachable, reported by check_document
residuals_not_counted: PLR-103: a dictionary with /S and a text key but no /P and no /Type is not a structure shape, so neither strip nor check reads it (unchanged boundary, pinned by structure_shape_is_read_from_the_parsed_dictionary)
